headline: Alabama survives Michigan State shootout in turnover-marred thriller
body: Alabama escaped with a 28-27 victory over Michigan State in a game that turned entirely on ball security. Both offenses moved the field with ease, combining for 784 yards and six touchdown passes, but Michigan State's three fumbles proved lethal in a one-point decision. Glass found Walsh for 119 yards and a score, and the Michigan State passing game was crisp enough to keep pace with Alabama's efficient attack, yet those turnovers created a gap neither Glass nor the offense could quite close.

James Cortez orchestrated the winning performance with composure and precision, completing 27 of 37 passes for 388 yards and three touchdowns. His poise in the pocket was the difference maker—he never turned the ball over and avoided the pressure mistakes that plagued Glass. Alabama's defense, anchored by Carter's sack and six tackles, applied just enough resistance to force Michigan State into mistakes when it mattered most. The Alabama secondary bent but didn't break, holding its ground as Glass aired it out 47 times.

What could have been a showcase offensive clinic became a cautionary tale about turnover margin. Michigan State dominated the line of scrimmage statistically, gaining 413 total yards to Alabama's 397, and actually out-rushed Alabama 42 to 21. But yardage doesn't account for those three fumbles that shifted momentum at critical junctures. Alabama will leave East Lansing knowing they won a game they didn't necessarily play better, a margin of luck that won't sustain them long term but proved decisive on this October afternoon.
turningPoint: Michigan State's third fumble in the fourth quarter, deep in Alabama territory with the game hanging in the balance, squandered what could have been a go-ahead score and handed Alabama the final possession it needed.

unsungHero.name: Fields
unsungHero.why: Fields caught six passes for 107 yards and two touchdowns—equaling half of Alabama's passing production—yet Cortez earned Player of the Game because his turnover-free execution defined the victory.
